Heart Explorer

A real human heart you can turn, open and listen to.

Pick a rhythm

Choose any of 19 rhythms in the left panel. The ECG, the beating heart, the valves and the heart sounds all follow it in real time. Display options sit in the toolbar above the heart.

Follow the blood

The heart opens so you can watch the flow. Take the guided tour, click any part to name it, then quiz yourself.

Mouse: Drag rotate · Scroll zoom · Right-drag pan

Keyboard: Space pause · ↑↓ next rhythm · ←→ tour steps · [] rotate heart · -= zoom · F full screen · ? help · Esc close

Every control works with a keyboard and a screen reader; changes are announced. Pause stops all motion. Sound is optional, and S1/S2 are also marked on the ECG strip.

Heart sounds are on. The green Sound on button in the toolbar above the heart turns them off.
